_model.node-single: Node http.createServer: 1 process, 1 event-loop thread (+ libuv pool threads), keep-alive
_model.node-cluster: Node cluster: primary + os.availableParallelism() = 10 worker processes sharing the listening socket, each = node-single
_model.rust-axum: Rust axum 0.8 on hyper 1 + tokio multi-thread runtime (worker thread per core), keep-alive
_model.py-stdlib: Python http.server ThreadingHTTPServer: OS thread per connection under the GIL, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, no dependencies
_model.py-uvicorn: Python uvicorn 0.39.0 (asyncio + h11, no httptools/uvloop) serving a 7-line ASGI app, 1 process, keep-alive
_model.rb-webrick: Ruby stdlib WEBrick 1.9.1: OS thread per connection under the GVL, keep-alive, no dependencies
_model.rb-puma: Ruby puma 6.6.1 single mode (default 0:5 threads under the GVL) + a 2-line rack 3 app, keep-alive
_model.php-builtin: PHP 8.5.10 built-in server `php -S`: 1 process, one request at a time, Connection: close, logs every request to stderr

_runtime.rust-axum: none: axum 0.8.9 / hyper 1.11.1 / tokio 1.53.1 / tower 0.5.3 statically linked (libSystem + libiconv)
_runtime.py-uvicorn: Python 3.9.6 + uvicorn 0.39.0, h11 0.16.0 (pip --user; httptools/uvloop not installed)
_runtime.php-builtin: PHP 8.5.10 NTS (Homebrew, 22 dependency formulae), binary 23795872 B

_install.rust-axum: `cargo new --name axum-hello axum`; Cargo.toml: axum = "0.8", tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net"] }; `cargo build --release` (crates.io, 18.9 s)
_install.rb-puma: `/usr/bin/gem install --user-install puma rack` -> rack-3.2.7 + nio4r-2.7.5 installed, puma FAILED (needs Ruby >= 3.0); then `/usr/bin/gem install --user-install puma -v 6.6.1` -> OK (33.9 s)
_install.php-builtin: `brew install php` -> php 8.5.10 + 22 dependencies (45.2 s); brings /opt/homebrew/opt/php/sbin/php-fpm (not configured, no nginx)
